courses.title: Feelings, Fame & Life Choices
courses.summary: Talk about emotions, work conversations, guilt, obstacles, and choosing a calmer life.
selected_content: When we were at the office the other day, you said you felt tired.
I didn’t know you felt this way.
Being famous also makes things difficult for me.
Sometimes I prefer a normal life to a crazy life.
